text:
Anika Patel: Heads-up — BlueCedar Labs sent over an LOI to list their 13B open model in the marketplace. Need a quick alignment on licensing, hosting rights, and joint announcement timing. Who can take point?

Jason Kim: I can own the marketplace listing side. Need legal clearance on hosting + redistribution rights first.

Leo Rivera: I can scope the SI + HW partner work (NimbleEdge) — key question: will BlueCedar provide quantized weights or just full fp16?

Maria Gomez: @Anika @Jason pinging legal-bot for an initial license scan. Also: any export controls / restricted dataset flags we should know about? :rotating_light:

legal-bot: Automated check: Detected third-party dataset mentions in model card. Recommend "Commercial Use Allowed" clause confirmation and provenance metadata. Upload license + model-card PDF to shared drive: https://drive.re/bluecedar_licensing (placeholder).

Anika Patel: Good — proposed go-to-market: soft-listing in Marketplace (US + EU) + co-announcement blog with BlueCedar in ~2 weeks. We need embargo window and co-branding assets. Does that timeline look feasible?

Jason Kim: Timeline OK if legal signs off by EOD tomorrow and Eng-Platform can prep SKU images + pricing by next Tue. Also need to confirm Dedicated/Private SKUs (reserved capacity + BYOW options).

Leo Rivera: NimbleEdge needs q4 quant artifact or conversion instructions. Quick integration checklist I'm thinking:
```
- model: bluecedar-13b
- quant: q4_0 or q8_1 (prefer q4 for edge)
- container: OCI image + sha256
- eval: small latency + perf harness
- env: CUDA 11 / ROCm compat
- test scripts: run_inference.sh + perf_report.json
```
If BlueCedar can't provide quant, Eng-ML will run conversion but need rights in the license to distribute quantized weights.

Maria Gomez: BlueCedar requested EU-only hosting for specific enterprise customers — need geoblocking clause and data residency in contract. Also check KMS/HSM requirements for Private deployments.

Anika Patel: Proposed responsibility map: Partnerships = announcement + partner comms; Eng-Platform = marketplace listing + SKUs; Eng-ML = quantization + evals; SI/HW (Leo) = integration & testing; Legal = license + export/compliance; Sales = pricing & co-sell. Agree?

Jason Kim: Agree. I'll draft the SKU table and pricing tiers tonight and share. 

Maria Gomez: I'll get Legal to confirm export/control language and geoblocking verbiage. @legal-bot can you surface any similar precedent docs?

legal-bot: Searching precedent... Found 3 similar supplier agreements (2023-2025). Recommend clause template: "Hosting, Redistribution, and Geoblocking Addendum v2". Uploading to drive.

Leo Rivera: If eng-ml needs more than 2 days for quant, call it out now. I can schedule a NimbleEdge integration slot next week.

Anika Patel: Action items: Jason -> SKU + pricing (tonight). Maria -> legal kickoff + export check (tomorrow). Leo -> integration slot + test harness list (next Wed). Jason/Eng-Platform -> marketplace asset checklist + embargo date. We'll reconvene tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:

Jason Kim: ack :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: ack, looping in Legal counsel after this thread.

Leo Rivera: ack. I'll drop the initial test harness link here when ready.

Anika Patel: Thanks all — trying to keep this lightweight so we can meet the partner's launch window. If anything blocks the announcement, flag here immediately.
